lines: As a king on earth is honored by all his people,
so the fallen yogin is honored by all the gods.
sanskrit_cite: viṣayeṣu sārvabhaumaḥ sarvajanaiḥ pūjyate yathā rājā | bhuvaneṣu sarvadaivair yogabhraṣṭas tathā pūjyaḥ

lines: After long years, birth regained and road walked,
he gets the deathless, whence none turn back.
sanskrit_cite: mahatā kālena punar mānuṣyaṃ prāpya yogam abhyasya | prāpnoti divyam amṛtam yasmād āvartate na punaḥ

lines: So the devoted on the true road here go to Siva.
Thinking this in truth, yet striving never stops.
sanskrit_cite: tasmāt sanmārge 'smin nirato yaḥ kaścid eti sa śivatvam | iti matvā paramārthe yathā tathāpi prayatanīyam

lines: Meditating this high brahman told brief by Abhinava,
Siva hood comes soon to dwell in his own heart.
sanskrit_cite: idam abhinavaguptoditasaṃkṣepaṃ dhyāyataḥ paraṃ brahma | acirād eva śivatvaṃ nijahṛdayāveśam abhyeti

lines: In a hundred verses this deep teaching pith is pressed,
by Abhinava, by me, lit by Siva's feet remembered.
sanskrit_cite: āryāśatena tad idaṃ saṃkṣiptaṃ śāstrasāram atigūḍham | abhinavaguptena mayā śivacaraṇasmaraṇadīptena
